title: Shape showcase
description: Every generator in one place: lathe, sweep with twist, extrude, tubes along knots and helices.

title: Castle
description: Curtain walls with 48 merlons, four towers, a keep, gatehouse, moat ring, bridge and a forest. About 190 objects.

title: Chess set
description: Italian opening on a wooden board. Every piece is a lathe profile, the knights are extruded silhouettes.

title: Space station
description: A rotating-wheel station with spokes, solar wings, docking modules, an antenna dish, an approaching shuttle and a ringed planet.

title: City block
description: A procedural downtown: 36 blocks, towers with setbacks, round glass towers, rooftop details and a park with a pond.

title: Alien garden
description: Tapered sweeps along procedural curves, glowing mushrooms, spiral shells and crystals, all placed on the terrain with probe_height.

title: Lighthouse island
description: A noise terrain island; the lighthouse and boat were placed on the surface and on the water with probe_height.
